title: Two days in Vung Tau
summary: Back Beach, bánh khọt, and Christ the King on the first day. Bach Dinh and Mary on Big Mountain on the second. Front Beach is the evening of either day.

days.title: Day 1 — Back Beach and the statue
days.body: Swim on Back Beach, eat bánh khọt on Nguyễn Trường Tộ, and climb Christ the King. Walk Front Beach after dark.

days.title: Day 2 — Big Mountain
days.body: Walk Bach Dinh in the afternoon, then Mary on the same hill. She holds the Child. Christ stands on Small Mountain.

stops.name: Back Beach
stops.note: Swim the flatter waves on the sunrise side of the peninsula.

stops.name: Banh khot
stops.note: Eat one cake at a time on Nguyễn Trường Tộ, wrapped in lettuce and herbs.

stops.name: Christ the King

approach.note: From the south end of Back Beach, then the steps.

stops.note: Climb about 800 steps to the feet of Christ the King on Small Mountain.

stops.name: Front Beach
stops.note: Walk the arc between the two mountains after dark.

stops.name: Bach Dinh

approach.note: Up the hill path from Front Beach.

stops.note: Walk the gardens and verandas of the white villa in the afternoon.

stops.name: Our Lady of Mulberry Beach
stops.note: See Mary holding the Child on the Big Mountain slope above Bãi Dâu.

additions.name: Ho May Park
additions.note: Ride the cable to the park on Big Mountain when the view or the rides are the point. Scenic adults 100,000 VND. A full visit is 475,000 VND.

seoTitle: Two days in Vung Tau — beach, then Big Mountain
seoDescription: Day one is Back Beach, bánh khọt, and Christ the King. Day two is Bach Dinh and Mary on Big Mountain.
